profile.name: Abhishek Anand
profile.summary: Full-stack software engineer specializing in scalable backend systems, Java, Spring Boot, and AWS cloud infrastructure. Experienced in API security, microservices architecture, and real-time observability.

highlights: Built and deployed cloud-native services on AWS (Lambda, EC2, VPC, S3, DynamoDB, CloudWatch) and integrated Okta-based authentication/authorization into application workflows.
Designed PostgreSQL and Redis schemas for efficient data access, and performed performance monitoring and debugging of services using Splunk, Honeycomb, and OpenTelemetry.
Contributing to an enterprise migration from a monolithic architecture to microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and Angular deployed across Azure/CentOS.
Integrated Next.js and React frontend modules with RESTful APIs in an Agile environment.
Built full-stack features using Spring Boot REST microservices, Spring MVC presentation layer, and MySQL persistence via JDBC/JPA.
Validated proficiency in core Java 17, OOP design patterns, SQL optimization, and algorithms through multi-stage FSE technical assessments.
Built foundational knowledge of cybersecurity, cloud computing, and data engineering supporting B2B/B2C service development.
